g.text: Welch panel, standard Wnt, shrinkage of the raw covariance with free scales. Orange: level chosen by the bulk likelihood. RMSE is not used by the selection.
Shaded: steps where the likelihood rises and the RMSE rises too (decoupled). Each panel has its own vertical scale.
Provisional: 2 / 35 / 39 Welch genes at 48 / 72 / 96 h are absent from the local scored_slots.rds and left out.
At 72 h the bulk likelihood rises from λ = 0.1 to 0.5 while the RMSE rises from 0.026 to 0.043
